summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a bundled obfuscated payload with it
details: @or-sdk/library-categories@0.2.8 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun` releases, extracts and chmods the binary, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against the bundled `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun-cjs` compiled bundle carrying classic obfuscator.io-style transforms: a large opaque string array, a shuffle routine, and a character-substitution decoder that reconstructs identifiers and strings at runtime. The package's advertised purpose is a library-categories SDK and has no functional need for the Bun runtime; fetching a second runtime solely to execute an obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based install-time scanners. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on `npm install` on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
